what_this_is: The INDEPENDENT validation of the D-3 statistics module. A second implementation, with a different algorithm at every step, was written and compared against the implementation under test. The protocol requires this before the arithmetic is used.

algorithm_differences.tail_probability: verifier uses a direct math.comb sum; the implementation uses an integer recurrence
algorithm_differences.inversion: verifier brackets by doubling then scans down; the implementation bisects
algorithm_differences.comparison: verifier compares exact Fractions; the implementation cross-multiplies integers
